headline: Software chains docking, MD setup, and pocket extraction around molecular structures
label: Molecular Structure Workflow Automation
summary: Automated pipelines now connect docking outputs to MD system setup, and toolkits streamline curation and model training for structure-based inputs.
synthesis: The dominant thread is software that automates the preparation and analysis steps surrounding molecular structures, from curation and visualization to simulation setup. CHARMM-GUI Ligand Docker unifies AutoDock Vina, Smina, RxDock, and DiffDock, applies PoseBuster filtering, and hands docked poses to MD system setup. MartiniSurf automates building GROMACS-ready Martini coarse-grained simulations of proteins and DNA immobilized on surfaces. MXtalTools provides a Python toolkit spanning dataset curation, model training, and crystal representation for molecular crystals. GYDE offers bench scientists visual access to AI tools for structure prediction and design. What is new is chaining these steps, where docking outputs feed MD setup. The methods are not shared across all items; the common element is workflow automation around structure-based inputs. The GPCR item is an analysis of experimental structural databases rather than a tool.
